comment: The release zips of OrderedJSON, which publishes to no registry for PHP: make crudui-install-composer runs make release-assets-fetch of kit, which downloads the PHP package zip into var/composer-artifacts, the Composer artifact repository of the root composer.json, whose form comparison server reads JSON with it. The extension zip is extracted into var/ordered-json-php-ext, whose src/ the record servers build the ordered_json PHP extension from.
